title.zh: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury
title.en: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury

current_state.zh: Strategy has spent roughly $950.8 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares since July 20, more than twice its Bitcoin purchases over the same period, while keeping about $1 billion authorized for further buybacks.
